originalTitle: Australia news live: Alan Jones complainant denies fabricating pigsty kiss; Atlassian shares soar after strong results
content: Atlassian share price surges Atlassian’s share price has surged after the Sydney-founded software giant beat investor expectations with stronger-than-predicted financial results. Shares in the tech company, which is listed on the New York stock exchange’s Nasdaq index, were up by more than 35% in extended trading on Thursday night, US time, or this morning in Australia, after it released its results for the 2025-2026 financial year and the last quarter. The company’s revenue for the fourth quarter of the 2025-2026 financial year grew to almost $US1.8bn (AUS $2.4bn), a 28% increase compared with the three months to 30 June 2025. Its strong quarterly results come right after it laid off 1,600 workers, or about 10% of its total workforce, including nearly 500 Australian staff, in March. The company is also forecasting it will earn more in the first quarter of this financial year than analysts were expecting. Atlassian, whose software tools such as ⁠Jira Service Management and Rovo are designed to help clients manage teams, track ‌work and analyse ‌data, has benefited from companies incorporating machine learning and adopting AI to automate tasks. In a note to investors, Atlassian’s CEO and co-founder, Mike Cannon-Brookes, said the company’s long-term strategy was paying off and it was finding its “edge” with new products such as its Teamwork Graph, a background system that collates work data and apps into a map. He said: In the AI era, context is the edge but it’s hard to build and can’t be hired. Thanks to 25 years of connecting teams, customers get one of the best context graphs for orchestrating agentic workflows. Simply put, the Teamwork Graph helps every customer get better, faster, and cheaper results with AI. Alan Jones trial continues The cross-examination of the first alleged victim to give evidence in Alan Jones’s indecent assault trial continues in Sydney’s Downing Centre local court. Complainant J, aged in his 40s, is one of six alleged victims of the former broadcaster, who has pleaded not guilty to 22 charges of indecent assault and sexual touching. J has been giving evidence for five days. The court has heard that Jones’s Fitzroy Falls farm was staffed by a butler, a cleaner and a maintenance man, with the latter living on the property with his family. Jones’s defence barrister Gabrielle Bashir SC has put to complainant J that he fabricated his evidence that Jones kissed him at a pigsty on the farm. Bashir said during cross-examination on Friday: “There was no kiss at the pigsty. It was a fabrication.” J replied: “No it wasn’t.” The trial continues. Sheikh Shadi Alsuleiman, the president of the Australian National Imams Council, has been giving evidence to the royal commission into antisemitism and social cohesion. The commission scheduled the sheikh to give evidence on a Friday, overlooking the fact that the sheikh is required to offer Friday prayers at his mosque. “My apologies,” commissioner Virginia Bell told Alsuleiman, “in planning we overlooked that consideration.” Alsuleiman told the commission he was placed on a “kill-list” by the so-called Islamic State because of his efforts to promote social cohesion and harmony across faiths. I was added to an Isis ‘kill-list’ of 30 religious leaders around the entire world. Alsuleiman told the commission: My personal opinion – which is the opinion of the Australian National Imams Council, and which we have been very public about – is that Isis is a terrorist, dangerous organisation that has no links to Islam. We’ve made that statement publicly in the past, and we reiterated this, that they are the enemy of the entire humanity, including Muslims. On the frontline of Australia’s bird flu outbreak, people are distressed It has only been three weeks since H5 bird flu was detected on South Australia’s Limestone Coast and already encounters with sick or dead birds are becoming commonplace. Maureen Christie, who lives in the seaside town of Carpenter Rocks, has been observing and protecting birds in the region for decades. She is now witnessing many stricken and suffering. “It’s just awful,” Christie said, who helped establish the Friends of Shorebirds SE more than 20 years ago. “We expected it but, now it’s here, it’s just traumatic.” Read more here: Privacy commissioner says smart glasses and wearable tech may require new laws Australia’s privacy commissioner, Carly Kind, has said the arrival of smart glasses with cameras, such as Meta’s Ray-Bans and Kmart’s Anko glasses, will “fundamentally alter our experience of interpersonal interactions” and requires consideration if new laws are required. In a blog post on Friday, Kind said: The proliferation of smart glasses – and their future peers, such as wearable pins or advanced earbuds – would fundamentally alter our experience of interpersonal interactions, in both private and public spaces … without knowing we could be filmed, recorded or photographed at any time. Kind said Australia’s Privacy Act only applies to businesses and government agencies, and there should be consideration on whether new laws are needed. As Australia’s privacy regulator we are giving serious consideration to the issues raised by surveillance wearables and monitoring their market presence in order to understand if scrutiny and intervention is required or warranted. We have engaged with one entity on at least two occasions this year to further understand the technical specifications of surveillance wearables on offer. In a nod to the public backlash to the glasses, Kind said public trust in tech companies is “extremely low” and the bar for establishing a social licence for new tech “will be high”. chineseTitle: 澳大利亚新闻直播：艾伦琼斯投诉人否认捏造猪圈之吻； Atlassian 业绩强劲后股价飙升
chineseContent: Atlassian 股价飙升 在这家总部位于悉尼的软件巨头以强于预期的财务业绩超出投资者预期后，Atlassian 股价飙升。这家在纽约证券交易所纳斯达克指数上市的科技公司公布了 2025-2026 财年和上一季度的业绩后，其股价在美国时间周四晚间或澳大利亚时间今天上午的盘后交易中上涨了 35% 以上。该公司 2025-2026 财年第四季度的收入增长至近 18 亿美元（24 亿澳元），与截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日的三个月相比增长了 28%。该公司在 3 月份解雇了 1,600 名员工（约占其员工总数的 10%，其中包括近 500 名澳大利亚员工），随后发布了强劲的季度业绩。该公司还预测，本财年第一季度的盈利将高于分析师的预期。 Atlassian 的 Jira Service Management 和 Rovo 等软件工具旨在帮助客户管理团队、跟踪工作和分析数据，该公司受益于采用机器学习和采用人工智能来自动化任务的公司。 Atlassian 首席执行官兼联合创始人迈克·坎农-布鲁克斯 (Mike Cannon-Brookes) 在给投资者的一份报告中表示，该公司的长期战略正在取得回报，并且正在通过 Teamwork Graph 等新产品找到自己的“优势”，Teamwork Graph 是一种将工作数据和应用程序整理成地图的后台系统。他说：在人工智能时代，上下文是优势，但它很难构建，也雇佣不到。得益于 25 年的团队联系，客户获得了用于编排代理工作流程的最佳上下文图之一。简而言之，Teamwork Graph 通过 AI 帮助每个客户获得更好、更快、更便宜的结果。艾伦琼斯审判继续进行
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
